visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The death is retaken with room at the left and bottom because the first take's tail swept past both edges; it sinks onto the belly and settles flat with the lanterns dimmed. The attack bites with the jaws open and skips the dark plates during the recovery; the defend holds the low guard before its plate darkens. The walk loops one cycle over 63-121. Idle, hit and cast are used as generated.
